question: The sum of the present ages of Sarala and Kishore is 26 years. If 3 years ago, Kishore was (3)/(2) times as old as Sarala, then the present age of Sarala is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of ages 3 years ago = 26 − (2 × 3) = 20 years.

Ratio of **Kishore** to **Sarala** 3 years ago = 3 : 2.

Total ratio parts = 3 + 2 = 5 units → 20 years ⇒ 1 unit = 4 years.

**Sarala** age 3 years ago = 2 units = 2 × 4 = 8 years.

Present age of **Sarala** = 8 + 3 = 11 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 11 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee398718d71361cec6ccc338883106042da84dfd015069634b2a62687256de31.png] 

**Given:** Sum of present ages = 26 years. Ratio (K:S) 3 years ago = 3 : 2.

⇒ Let **Sarala** present age be x and **Kishore** present age be y.

⇒ x + y = 26

⇒ 3 years ago: (y − 3) = 3/2 × (x − 3)

⇒ 2y − 6 = 3x − 9 ⇒ 3x − 2y = 3

⇒ From first eq, y = 26 − x. Substitute: 3x − 2(26 − x) = 3

⇒ 3x − 52 + 2x = 3 ⇒ 5x = 55

⇒ x = 11 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 11 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Age Ratio Shift

When moving 'n' years back in time for two people, the sum of their ages decreases by 2n.

Constant Difference

The difference between the ages of two persons remains constant throughout their lives, regardless of the years passed.</p
